page.overview:
What is Awakened Form?

The is the form the race of the Heeters take on by retaining control of themselves once they have unleased their inner nature.

This form had no official name as of the interview with Toyotarou in August of 2022, he had come up with a name for it but had not yet discussed it with Akira Toriyama. The form was later referred to as the "Awakened Form" in the Dragon Ball Super Interval Special.

When a user of this form cannot fully control their unleashed inner nature, they can only use a portion of its power, needing to take on the Inner Nature Unleashed state in order to manifest it fully.

40 years before the Granolah the Survivor Saga, the young Gas utilized this form against Bardock but despite being at an advantage, unwillingly further transformed into the Inner Nature Unleashed state as a result of his frustration.
